title: How to bring reporting back
intro: The bots (LIT / ATLAS / BLITZ) never needed GitHub to trade. Only their reporting did. This puts the reporting on your main PC.

steps.title: Update the bot folder from the zip
steps.text: Stop the bot (STOP_BOT.bat). Put the code zip and its .sha256.txt in Downloads on the PC, open the zip, copy UPDATE_FROM_ZIP.bat into the bot folder and double-click it. It checks the zip, keeps your settings and every local file, and shows six lines. Best time: 17:00-18:00 ET or the weekend.

steps.title: Make a free Netlify site and a token
steps.text: Site: app.netlify.com/drop, drop any file, note the Site ID (Site configuration, "Site ID"). Token: Netlify > your avatar > User settings > Applications > Personal access tokens > New access token > copy it.

steps.title: Save both on the PC
steps.text: In the bot folder, one line, then paste the token and press Enter (it is typed hidden, never shown or uploaded):

steps.title: Double-click PUBLISH_NQ.bat
steps.text: It sets up the 15-minute task, switches the bot to GitHub-free mode and publishes once.

steps.title: Start the bot again
steps.text: Double-click START_BOT.bat while the market is closed. STATUS.bat any time shows the last publish.

undo: Undo: UNDO_UPDATE.bat puts the old files back; UNDO_PUBLISH_NQ.bat removes the publish task.
limits: Netlify's new free plan allows about 20 deploys a month (each costs 15 of 300 credits; at zero the site pauses). So the publisher keeps a budget: at most 1 a day, 18 a month by default, and says so on its status line.
Check your real limit at app.netlify.com > Usage (the price page can change).
The phone live view (minute-by-minute) and phone remote control used GitHub; they are off. Phone alerts from the cloud monitor are gone; PC-side alerts still work.
Auto-update of the bot from GitHub is off: update with the zip and UPDATE_FROM_ZIP.bat (step 1).
